subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — following up on the two $89 entries on packet packet WC-12 and my earlier ticket the prior packet WC-11. When I called the packet scanner about the second entry, they said it isn't a routine authorization hold — it's connected to a review that's already open on my account (the WC-12 onboarding record), which is why it hasn't released.

the packet scanner opened dispute DSP-55821 for the held $89 and told me the hold can only be reconciled if the reference on the account case appears on the merchant's written reply email — that is how their matching works. They rejected a general "a hold was placed" because there was nothing to match against. The reference is the label already on my own onboarding record, not the scoring logic or thresholds behind it.

Can you help me get this dispute moving? I'm stuck between your support and the packet scanner, and I can't get the packet released without the reply email matching the hold on their side.
